lessons.title: Which Meeting Is the Final One?
lessons.goal: 辨識訊息更新後的時間、地点與人數。
lessons.story:
[Group chat: Poster team]
Monday, 4:10 p.m.
Tina: Let’s meet in the library at four tomorrow. We can finish our poster before the school closes at five.
Rex: I have music practice until four fifteen. Can we start at four twenty?
Tina: That should work. We need about thirty minutes.

Monday, 7:00 p.m.
Tina: Update: the library has a meeting tomorrow afternoon. We’ll use Room 203 instead. The starting time stays the same.
Rex: Got it. Four twenty in Room 203. I’ll bring the photos.
Lulu: I can’t arrive before four forty. Should you wait for me?
Tina: No. We’ll start with the photos. Please bring the title letters when you arrive.
Lulu: Okay. I’ll read this latest message again before leaving home.
Rex: Good idea. The first plan is still visible, but it is no longer the one we will follow.

words.example: Lulu will arrive at four forty.
The old plan is still visible.

questions.prompt: Where will the team finally meet?
reasons: Rex 練音樂不代表在音樂室開會。

questions.prompt: What is the shortest possible gap between the meeting’s start and Lulu’s arrival?
questions.evidence: Lulu: I can’t arrive before four forty.
reasons: 可能較晚抵達，但不是最短時差。

questions.explanation: latest message 指更新之後最近一則有效訊息。
questions.evidence: I’ll read this latest message again before leaving home.

questions.prompt: Why won’t the team wait for Lulu?
options: They can work on the photos before she brings the letters.
She is bringing the wrong materials.
The meeting has already been canceled.
They do not need a title anymore.
questions.explanation: Tina 把照片先做、字母後帶，讓分工配合不同抵達時間。
questions.evidence: We’ll start with the photos. Please bring the title letters when you arrive.
reasons: 分段工作使會議能先開始。

questions.prompt: Which summary contains the final plan?
options: Start Tuesday at 4:40 in the library with the title letters.
Start Monday at 7:00 in the library with everyone.
Start Tuesday at 4:20 in Room 203, with Lulu joining later.
Start Tuesday at 4:00 in Room 203 and wait for Lulu.
questions.explanation: 整合星期一說tomorrow、時間調整16:20、換教室及不等Lulu四個條件。
questions.evidence: The first plan is still visible, but it is no longer the one we will follow.
reasons: 四項條件都依最新對話。
